title: Gourmia Recalls 9-Slice Digital Air Fryer Ovens Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The oven’s doors can unexpectedly close when bumped, posing a burn hazard to consumers retrieving hot food. Units: About 175,951.

title: Bose Recalls Lithium-Ion Battery Packs for S1 Pro and S1 Pro+ Bluetooth Speaker Systems Due to Risk of Injury from Fire and Overheating Hazards
summary: The recalled lithium-ion battery packs can overheat and ignite, posing a risk of injury from fire and overheating hazards. Units: About 634,759 (In addition, about 35,400 were sold in Canada).

title: Kikea Store Recalls X-VESOLJE Nursing Pillows Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Suffocation; Violate Mandatory Standards for Nursing Pillows
summary: The recalled nursing pillows violate the mandatory safety standards for nursing pillows because they can obstruct an infant’s breathing, posing a serious risk of injury or death from suffocation. Units: About 19,596.

title: Little Giant Recalls Ladders with Rapid Locks Due to Risk of Serious Injury from Fall Hazard
summary: The ladders can suddenly retract if the Rapid Locks are not fully engaged, posing a fall hazard to consumers.

title: Magnetopia Recalls Magnetic Building Cubes and Blocks Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Magnet Ingestion Hazard
summary: The recalled magnetic building cubes contain magnets that can become loose if the cubes break or open, posing a magnet ingestion hazard to children. title: Vanderhall North America Recalls All Model Year 2024-2026 Brawley Electric Recreational Off-road Vehicles Due to Injury and Crash Hazards
summary: The seat belts in Brawley ROVs can permanently lockup in the fully retracted position. If this occurs, consumers would be unable to reset the seat belt and put it on when the vehicle is operating, posing injury and crash hazards to consumers. Units: About 190.

title: Baby Brezza Enterprises Recalls SuperFast Sterilizer Dryers Due to Overheating and Burn Hazards
summary: The recalled sterilizer dryers can overheat when plugged in and operating, posing a risk of injury from a burn hazard if the surface is handled. Units: About 29,000 (In addition, about 4,500 were sold in Canada).

title: C.A.M.P. Recalls Mountain Ice Axes Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fall Hazard
summary: A screw on the recalled mountain ice axes can loosen during use, causing the handle or pick to detach, posing a risk of serious injury or death from fall hazard. Units: About 2,230.

title: Jiastfeng Recalls HAUOMS Eight-drawer Dressers Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Tip-Over and Entrapment Hazards; Violate Mandatory Standard for Clothing Storage Units
summary: The recalled dressers are unstable if they are not anchored to the wall, posing tip-over and entrapment hazards that can result in risks of serious injuries or death to children. The dressers violate the mandatory safety standards as required by the STURDY Act. Units: About 1,392.

summary: The bicycles violate the mandatory safety regulation for bicycles, because they are not equipped with a chain guard.
